prompt: All university undergraduate courses should include a period of time spent studying abroad or doing a work placement. Do you think the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Nowadays, it is clear that many universities' undergraduate courses have the option to study abroad or the choice to do a work placement. In my opinion, the advantages of these are relevant , and every student should have the opportunity and the chance to carry out their studies abroad.

It is evident that a large part of universities in the world include some programs in a different country during a certain period of time, but also an effort in placement or an internship. For instance, many business school in Europe gives the chance to do a program. Namely, “Erasmus”, which offers a large variety of other schools in Europe with different study paths. Moreover, it is very helpful for students to discover other cultures, customs and other ways of doing business.

Learning in another school or doing an internship can have many benefits and advantages because it can help undergraduates to understand better how working in another city can be. For example, a survey conducted by the University of Shanghai and published by the teacher Gazate in 2024 proves that many undergraduates come from far to discover better how the world works. In addition, people coming from  other continents believe that it is very refreshing to learn in another country.

To conclude, I definitely believe that there is a large variety of advantages of studying or doing an internship in different places and having the option to do an exchange study path can help to understand and grasp other ways of learning.
